title: Buffalo Grill alerts all customers after unauthorised access to its subcontractor Brevo's tool
date_note: Cyberattaque.org gives only its publication day; the letter's date and the date of the access are not stated.
geo_basis: country; the source names no city
summary: Buffalo Grill's letter, relayed by Cyberattaque.org, says unauthorised access to the tool of its subcontractor Brevo exposed customers' names, email addresses, phone numbers and, where given, postal codes. The chain says no banking data or passwords were affected and that it estimates the incident concerns about ten people, but notified all customers. It says it notified the CNIL.
plain: Restaurant chain Buffalo Grill says someone accessed its supplier Brevo's tool and some customer contact details were exposed. It says no bank data or passwords were involved and it has told all customers.
exec: A supplier's tool exposed contact data of Buffalo Grill customers; the chain says it concerns about ten people but alerted everyone.
action: Buffalo Grill advises customers to be wary of unexpected solicitations; questions can go to dcp@buffalo-grill.fr.

evidence.quote: L’enseigne estime que l’incident concerne un nombre très limité de clients, évalué à environ dix personnes.

validation.note: Only Cyberattaque.org read; it relays Buffalo Grill's letter to customers, which was not read directly.

review.note: data types, about ten people, CNIL, advice checked against Cyberattaque.org; single_source
